answer: A new identity serves a probation of 11 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the beacon queue naming the glacier that holds the sponsor's bond. Therefore, each duplicate self costs 11 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the hollow record reveals exactly who is still on probation. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
